nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray

avis.titre: I feel in love with this product
avis.texte: Love how smooth and evenly it layers on the skin and slowly settles... feels smooth and has helped with a few of my fine lines. I absolutely love this product

I love this spray as part of my skincare routine and anytime I feel like my face needs some hydration. It doesn't breakdown my makeup which is great. I continue to repurchase this item as soon as my current one starts getting low. 10/10 would recommend

I like that this serum spray absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky film. My skin feels lightly hydrated after using it, but I do still need a proper moisturizer layer. It does give a subtle glow, like a healthy, slightly dewy finish rather than that intense "glass skin" look people hype up. It works well as a midday refresh too!

avis.titre: Definitely has became part of my am/pm routine
avis.texte: I really enjoy this mist and use it right after washing my face, before applying makeup. It feels lightweight and refreshing, and gives my skin a nice boost of hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. It helps prep my skin well and layers smoothly under makeup with no pilling. It also leaves a subtle, healthy glow. I would definitely repurchase this.

I always get dry skin during the winter months and try to keep my skin barrier moisturized, using this for a month I found that it did keep my skin moist and dewy. I do enjoy having a dewy look and it worked well with my every day life, I was able to keep on hand in my purse so anytime I felt dry I could easily spray and continue my day. I do wish it lasted a bit longer but it could be the harsh winter weather making it hard to do so.

This is such a nice and refreshing product. I can't wait to use in the summer. It leaves my skin looking dewy when I apply it at night and I think my makeup sits better the next day, looking hydrated. The mist is so fine and it has a nice light scent. A few things I wish were different - the mist is almost too fine, I feel like half of it dissipates before it reaches my face. I wish the spray were a bit more targeted so I doesn't feel like I'm wasting any product. Also I noticed some clogged pipes when I use this too many days in a row. I think it breaks me out a tiny bit. I will continue to finish up the product, just be careful if you have sensitive, acne prone skin.
Overall, this is a good product. I mainly used it throughout the day to refresh my skin. It's not sticky. It leaves my skin feeling a bit moisturized.
This serum spray is incredibly lightweight and sprays very fine, yet is very hydrating. I've even used it as a makeup setting spray. The scent may be bothersome if you are sensitive to smells.

I was confused what this spray benefits actually were meant to be. Aside from making my face look shiny, I did not see anything else to brag about. Also, when I used this product, I didn't feel refreshed or cooled or tingly ... nothing.

I received the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum as a gifted sample, and I'm honestly so impressed. I have mature skin, so hydration and glow are key for me, and this delivers. I've never tried a spray serum before, but the fine mist feels so refreshing and lightweight. I use it right after the shower, and it instantly makes my skin feel hydrated and plump while locking in moisture. It also gives the prettiest subtle glow ✨ I love using a few spritzes after makeup for that dewy, glass-skin finish. I've been pairing it with the Double Serum All-In-One Multi Balm Stick, and my skin has been feeling smooth, refreshed, and moisturized. Such an easy step that makes a big difference, definitely a new staple for me.

avis.titre: Refreshing, But More of a Mist Than a Serum
avis.texte: I use the d'Alba Refresh Aqua Serum mostly right after my setting spray and throughout the day when I want a quick refresh. First thing I noticed is how cooling it feels on the skin. It's really nice, especially mid-day when my face needs a little pick me up. It doesn't mess up my makeup, which I appreciate, and it gives a light, fresh feel. That said, I think of this more as a refreshing mist than a true "serum." It feels hydrating in the moment, but I wouldn't rely on it for long-lasting moisture or major skincare benefits. It's a nice extra step if you like facial mists and want something lightweight and cooling, just not a must-have in my routine.
I think the spray is so refreshing, and I love the way it smells, but I honestly wouldn't get it again once it's out. I just didn't feel like it does much.

I'm closing in on 50 far too quickly and my skin suddenly got wicked wrinkled in the past two years (why?!). I started using this at the same time as their balm so I can't be 100% sure why I made the biggest difference but this has totally replaced my serum. I love that it's a spray and these things work! The balm definitely helped my winter dry skin but I'll be using this serum year-round. My skin looks and feels better. I'm not sure it's changed my wrinkles a ton but my skin is so much more plump and lush that they don't look at deep.

This spray has a super fine mist, you almost can't even feel it on your skin. The fragrance is very subtle and fresh. I was worried the truffle scent might be overpowering but I wouldn't even be able to tell it was truffle by the smell. The spray leaves your skin very dewy and refreshed. I spray this constantly, whenever my skin needs a pick-me-up. Great product.
This is refreshing to hydrate my skin especially using before makeup. It has nice hydrating ingredients. I'm not entirely sure if it can be used as a setting spray.

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase this product!
avis.texte: I used this product throughout the day and loved it! It kept my skin plump and very moisturized.
I used this product consistently since I received it. When you spray the product it has a strong chemical like smell.
Which a pretty bottle, used on a hot day and instantly cooled face and gave a dewy moisture boost. Really like it for daily use
Lightweight and refreshing, this serum absorbs beautifully and gives an instant boost of hydration. My skin feels calm, cool, and noticeably more radiant.
I love this mist as it feels so refreshing on the skin. Especially when it's hot out and gives a little added moisture. I've never used a skin mist before but I think I'll be a forever user now.

I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This product is great to keep in a purse during hot day as it refreshes you instantly, and the mist is so fine that it doesn't ruin the makeup. I recommend!

avis.titre: Nice mist, but not my favorite
avis.texte: This mist was definitely good for a light hydration but I felt it lacked any special qualities that made it stand out in the market other than hydration alone. I like it and will finish it but probably won't repurchase. I use it to set my makeup like in the photo

I like to use this product especially on in office days bc my skin tends to get drier. The spray is a nice refresh from for my skin. It's feels good and makes my skin appear less dull throughout the day. It has a light pleasant scent.

In order to activate the spray, you have to mix the blue and white by slightly shaking it. It's a refreshing spray to use in the morning before my makeup. It absorbs pretty easily and doesn't cause breakouts on my skin. No strong scent.
I love how fine this mist is and how dewy it makes my skin look. It's also super pretty, which is also a bonus to me.

This product smells great, but if you are sensitive to fragrance, beware! I really liked the moisture this provided to my face. I had some really dry skin on the left side of my face. Unfortunately, I developed several deep, painful pimples within a day or two of spraying it, specifically on that left hand side.

avis.titre: Nice lightweight pick me up for skin
avis.texte: I use this product in the morning after I wash my face, before I put my makeup on. It is refreshing and absorbs well, and didn't leave my skin oily. It felt moisturized but not greasy. I am actually planning to put this in the fridge when it gets hot so it's extra refreshing!

I received this product free on exchange for my review. This serum spray is very nice and leaves my skin feeling smooth and glowy. It is fragranced but it isn't too heavy. Do not breathe in when spraying or after spraying the product. I accidentally made this mistake.

I have pretty dry skin and live in LA, where it is hot. This serum spray is so refreshing! I use it as a face mist to refresh my face during the day. It smells great and feels like my skin is softer. Easy to use bottle with a nice mist.

I really loved this product. I took it with me on vacation, and it was the perfect moisturizing mist! There is not really a smell and it left my skin feeling refreshed and soft. The ingredients are clean and overall I would recommend it.

Give it a little shake and spritz all over your face. My skin absorbs this almost instantly! My face feels so hydrated I use it in the morning and at night or if I need a little refresher. I feel like I need to try the whole skin care line now my skin is doing so good

I've been using this spray for a few days now and honestly, I didn't expect to like it this much. It feels super refreshing on the skin, especially during the day when my face starts to feel dry or tired. The mist is really fine (not those annoying big droplets), and it gives a nice glow without making me oily. I also love how lightweight it feels — like skincare and a little luxury moment in one. Definitely something I'll keep in my bag.
It is a great hydrating spray. I can use it as part of my skincare routine, or anytime in the day for a quick refresh. It is very light and does not break me out.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Hydrating, and Perfect for Everyday Glow
avis.texte: I use this spray serum right after washing my face and sometimes before makeup, and it instantly makes my skin feel fresh and hydrated. What I like the most is that it's very lightweight but still gives a nice glow and moisture without feeling greasy. It also cools the skin and absorbs fast, which is great in hot weather. The only small issue is that you have to shake it well before using and some people might not like the scent, but overall it's a really good hydrating mist

I have skin that's dehydrated and on the oilier side and this White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray from d'Alba is great. It gives my skin a dewy look and absorbs easily. The smell is the only thing I wish were more floral but herbal is fine.

I like to keep this spray at my desk, for when my face feels dry or I feel tired. Weather is currently transitioning from winter to spring, so the cold air is still drying my skin out. The serum spray has been working wonders to keep my skin hydrated, and gives me a nice healthy glow.

D'alba sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program. As for my opinion, this product feels great on the skin. It leaves the skin feeling moisturized with a dewy finish. However, it doesn't leave a sticky finish on the skin.

I have been using this white truffle refresh aqua serum after washing my face, both morning and night. It is refreshing light mist, that preps my skin for my face oil and moisturizers. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and doesn't cause any irritation.

This is a wonderful hydrating serum. I love how quick it absorbs and is so gentle on my skin. It gives my skin a slight plumping look but also gives my skin a little glow to skin. I love that it can be used by both men and women , great for sensitive skin and oily skin and is not greasy.

I recieved this item in exchange for an honest review and must say this went above my expectations. I tried this bare faced as well as with a full face of make-up. This was such a light mist that it absorbed nicely without leaving droplets or smudging my make-up. I was able to use it throughout the day and had no issues.

This White Truffle Spray Serum, Korean Formula is very easy to use. An appropriate amount is dispensed when applying. It smooths on your skin easily and absorbs well. It is very hydrating and gives a healthy glow.

Thanks D'Alba for the White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum spray. My skin drinks this serum up! It's ultra lightweight, sinks in fast, and I love that it gives me a fresh, dewy look without making me look oily. I've also noticed my skin looks smoother because it's more hydrated. I've been using it in the morning after I prep my skin and before doing my makeup and haven't had any issues with my foundation separating. It's definitely a good everyday serum, especially if you want hydration without the grease.

I got this complimentary from d'Alba. This spray is super refreshing! It is easy to use and sprays evenly on my face, even over my makeup. My face feels really hydrated and cool. It has a nice scent that isn't overpowering. I would recommend this for freshening up!

This serum spray has left my face feeling refreshed. I have been using it through the day whenever my face feels dry. As soon as you spray it leaves a cooling effect. I tend to have dry and redness and this helped a lot. It's not sticky at all and can be used after applying makeup.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I have not tried a spray product like this before, but I really love it! It feels moisturizing and fresh but stays light especially under makeup. I have been pairing this after use of double multi serum balm and my skin is smooth and hydrated without being greasy. I live in a warm, dry climate and this has felt especially great on my skin with temperatures heating up. My skin continues feeling soft and refreshed at the end of the day. I will definitely look to continue purchasing.

This has been a really fun self care item that I enjoy using daily. I spray it on both in the morning and at night for some extra moisturizer. I haven't noticed any super noticeable difference in my skin, but it works well under my make up and has not broken me out. It feels like a little something extra that I can do for myself to take care of my skin.

avis.titre: Is This Water? Why Do I Need This?
avis.texte: The packaging was written primarily in Korean (which is cool and I assume it's authentic) but I was left without an understanding of how or why to use the product, let alone what the benefits are. I tried different approaches- morning, both before and after make up as well as evening, after cleansing and moisturizing. Bottom line - it feels like I'm spraying water on my face.
This spray keeps my skin hydrated and feeling refreshed all day long! I use it through the day to keep my skin glowing.

This serum spray has been a great addition to my routine. It has a refreshing cooling effect and gives my skin an instant boost of hydration, making it feel softer and more balanced right away. The mist is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any residue, so it's perfect for reapplying throughout the day. It layers well with other products and hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts.
Been loving this serum spray, it's extremely practical and easy to use so I never skip, cooling but moisturizing at the same time, very nice for everyday skincare routine .

avis.titre: Easy to use and spray throughout the day
avis.texte: I love that it's such an easy to use product. I usually use this as my base layer before applying any other makeup or skin products. It does have a floral scent, so if you're sensitive to smells I would not recommend this product, but if not I think it helped make my skin look more moisturized and bouncy. It's been really dry where I live and I've had to layer on more products to keep my skin from drying out, but this was so easy to spray and also just spray on throughout the day when I felt my skin getting tight and dry.

I recently tried the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray and I'm honestly impressed! The mist is super fine and lightweight, making it perfect for a quick refresh throughout the day—even over makeup. It instantly hydrates and gives my skin a dewy, healthy glow without feeling greasy. I also love the cooling sensation, which feels especially nice when my skin is dry or irritated. Overall, it's a great pick for anyone looking for an easy, refreshing boost of hydration.

avis.titre: Never knew what I was missing
avis.texte: I didn't know about this so I didn't really know what to expect. I had no idea what I was missing out on! I've used this for two weeks and it's incredible! So hydrating and light!

Great mist to give a quick pick me up, feeling crisp and clean. The bottle will tell you to close your eyes and hold your breath, they aren't lying, don't inhale! The fine mist lingers (which is a bonus for your skin), but step away from where you sprayed before taking a breath in. Pleasant scent, feels great on and absorbs quickly.

This product is super refreshing on my face and has such a pleasant smell! It's mostly neutral with some sweet undertones. I love to use this in the morning & evening. This serum spray has become integrated into my skincare routine and would recommend this product.

avis.titre: Soft moisturized skin in a spray
avis.texte: d'alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray Is a refreshing way to get soft moisturized skin. My face felt refreshed and looked younger after a few days using this. It was a mini spa experience. I received a free bottle in exchange for an honest review.

This is the first time I try the spray serum and I am impressed by how light and refreshing it is. It does not feel greasy. I try to use it during the day as a mist as well to stay moisturized. This item was provided to me by the brand as a free sample.

I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Aqua Serum Spray for a while, and it's a great everyday mist. The spray is super fine and gives a quick dewy glow without feeling greasy—perfect for refreshing makeup. It adds light hydration, but dry skin will still need a moisturizer. It also has a noticeable scent, which I don't mind but might not be for everyone.
I've been using this as it's been warming up outside and my skin has been needing more refreshes. It goes on nicely, the spray is consistent and my skin drinks it up. I love this stuff.
Love the way this feels. Makes my face feel fresh and smooth. Also has a light nice scent. I'd buy this again!!
I'm not sure I feel any benefit. It's nice to spray on, but my face doesn't feel more moisturized. I'll continue to use the product. Not bad, but not great.
So easy to use and it gives my skin a refresh. Although I received it complimentary, I highly recommend. My skin is glowing from this. It's so good
I'm really enjoying d'alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray. it feels so refreshing and makes my skin dewy.

This serum is very softening and moisturizing. Ive been using it twice a day and ive noticed ive had less dry skin around my nose and mouth. I feels soothing after a shower. The smell is beautiful and the texture isnt sticky or greasy. It absorbs pretty quickly so I can layer the rest of my skin care products

I'm loving this serum spray. It is lightweight, feels refreshing on my skin, and has become a regular addition to my morning regiment. I've noticed a difference in my skin, it is more radiant and hydrated after using for a few weeks. And bonus, the bottle looks nice on my bathroom counter.
Good for a quick refresh of hydration and light sheen. It's good but very very light, spray generously!

I have been testing the White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray ever since I received it from d'Alba as part of an educational promotion. I love how refreshing and calming the spray is on my skin, and that it can be used over makeup. This makes it convenient to apply throughout the day, and I can use it as a finishing spray to add a glow to my skin. Be aware that it has a strong perfume-like scent. It smells really nice as long as you enjoy scented products.

I really like using the d'Alba Refresh Aqua Serum. This bottle is a spray that gives me a very soft fine mist. I use about 3 spray for my face. It has a nice light scent that is soft and pleasing. The spray gives my skin a hydrating feeling. My face feels dry with the fans on and this really helps. It's a light, nice cooling sensation that dissipates once it absorbs. It's really a great relief when my face feels dry and needs a refresh. Plus this is dermatologist recommended! I will continue to use this. I received this item free in exchange for my opinion.
I love this spray it helps with refreshing my makeup when I'm on the go. It gives it a glow without looking overly oily. Just the right amount of hydration needed for my skin to breathe.

I received this product complimentary for my honest review. I really like this product and find it gives my skin a nice refreshed look. It has a slight scent to it on first application but it goes away very quickly. The mist is very fine and doesn't leave my skin feeling weighed down. I usually apply it with a clean face before going to bed but I will start using at as a refresh throughout the day. I've also heard it's great for a dewy skin look after applying makeup. This product has many uses that I'm interested in exploring!
This is a fresh spray, looking forward to trying it during the hotter months. Seems hydrating, non sticky and nice smell!
These white truffle products are my absolute favorites! Not only are they great quality face-care, but they smell amazing & look so classy
I really do like this serum spray. I spritz it on after I cleanse and before my moisturizer. It's also a nice refresher during the day when my skin feels dehydrated. Also, it smells amazing!!!

I received this product for free through a testing program, but this review reflects my honest opinion. The d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray has quickly become one of my favorite face mists. It feels incredibly refreshing and soothing, especially right after cleansing or during the day when my skin needs a quick boost of hydration. The spray itself is very fine and delicate—it doesn't leave drops or disturb makeup, which makes it perfect for touch-ups throughout the day. I also appreciate that it doesn't cause any irritation, redness, or breakouts on my sensitive, combination skin. It leaves my face feeling cool, calm, and lightly hydrated with a subtle, healthy glow. Elegant packaging, pleasant scent, and a truly gentle formula that feels like skincare luxury in a mist.

This serum spray was cooling and refreshing and my my skin look and feel Dewey and moisturized! I can't wait to use it when warmer weather comes because I bet it will be amazing then with the cooling sensation! It feels great and makes my skin look happy, win-win!
Lightweight spray that leaves my skin feeling hydrated and not greasy. I like to use this spray to cool down my skin in the hot weather.

This product is a good refresher throughout the day. It gives a nice, glowing look without feeling too heavy or looking oily. It's a great addition to a regimen that's already in place. I could see myself getting this product again.
I started using this product in my skin care routine and noticed my skin had a nice glow with it - great addition to the routine!

I received this product from BzzAgent for my review. It's a decent spray to refresh your skin in the middle of the day but didn't help to maintain my makeup's staying power. It leaves a slight tingly sensation and leaves my skin looking and feeling dewy.

I wanted to love this but it's just okay. The mist is really fine and refreshing and it gives a quick glow but it doesn't last very long and I didn't notice any real difference in my skin over time. It's nice for a quick refresh but for the price I expected more. Probably wouldn't repurchase.

I absolutely love this d'laba serum mist. I use it as a toner in the morning. It has a lovely cooling effect. A wonderful fresh scent, slightly different than the traditional d'laba scent. My favorite way to use this is as a makeup refresh. Anytime my makeup was looking dry and crusty. I just sprayed this over my face and I have an instant glow and my make up is refreshed. This is my first time trying this brand, I see what all the hype is about. I absolutely love it. The glass bottle is such a nice luxurious touch. I want more d'laba.

avis.titre: Hydration? Yes! Glow? Very much so!
avis.texte: I received this product for free from D'Alba in exchange for my honest review. I've been using it for close to two weeks and I am so happy with it! The instant refresh and hydration are amazing—but the glow… oh mama! My skin is looking so radiant, it's making me feel young again. Safe to say, I'll be coming back for this one again and again.

I started using the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum spray it gives my skin instant hydration. It doesn't makes my skin oily instead it refresh my skin and make it fresh. I love the ingredients, it has moisturizer and serums. I carry this with me and spray on my face when needed.

avis.titre: Cool, refreshing and easy to apply
avis.texte: This facial mist's applicator provides a fine continuous spray that allows you to apply this serum evenly and effectively. With a slight cooling effect, this serum is not only effective, it is refreshing. Highly recommended.

This mist stands out compared to others I've tried because of how lightweight and instantly refreshing it feels. A lot of facial sprays either feel sticky or don't seem to do much, but this one actually delivers a noticeable cooling effect,especially in warm weather, and absorbs quickly without disturbing makeup. One of the biggest benefits is how easy it is to use throughout the day. It takes just a few seconds to mist on, making it perfect for a quick refresh when your skin feels dry or overheated. It also helps calm redness and gives your skin a more hydrated, comfortable feel. That said, it works best as a supplement rather than a replacement, you'll still want to use a regular moisturizer for deeper hydration. I would buy this product again, particularly for hotter months or to keep in my bag for on-the-go use and definitely recommend it to friends and family, especially anyone looking for a quick, no-fuss way to refresh and hydrate their skin during the day.

I have skin that feels tight, heated, and sometimes irritated during the day, this Aqua Serum Spray is a refreshing. It feels like water and treats your skin while it cools it. It has a wonderful fresh smell and leaves your skin feeling light. There is no sticky feeling like some serums. It can be used on top of make-up for a quick pick me up.

Very light weight that works well woth my oily skin. Did not make me look shinier but provided refreshing moisturizer. Worked fine before or after makeup, very versatile. Did not necessarily notice reduced redness.

I never knew there was such a thing as a syringe spray. I've only ever used serum in liquid form and they all have tended to be very greasy for my skin. I've been using this product for about two weeks and I love it. The spray comes out very fine and covers my face better than other sprays. I also love how this serum can be used before, during and after makeup. I'm able to save a bit of money buying less products overall. I'm Soo thankful I was given this serum to try for free. Otherwise I might never have known about it. Now it's part of my makeup and skin routine.

I was skeptical when I read serum and spray in the same product, but it actually works. It's very hydrating without the overwhelming sticky feeling and absorbs nicely. It does have a stronger scent, so if scents aren't your thing, this may not be for you.
This is such a refreshing spray that is excellent on a hot day. It smells incredible and instantly cools. I feel like I'm walking into a spa every time I use it.

avis.auteur: A moisture boost whenever you need it!
avis.texte: The d'alba Piedmont Refresh Aqua Serum is a refreshing cooling and moisturizing spray. Be sure to shake the bottle a few times before spraying 4-5 times over face area. Be sure to close your mouth and eyes and do not breathe in during the application. After spraying, gently pat into your skin. This spray includes white truffle from Piemonte, Italy in Trufferol, which is a powerful antioxidant complex that supports smoothing lines and elasticity. It also contains Canadian Glacial Water to hydrate and soothe sensitive skin. Blue Tanji Flower oil to reduce redness and minimize irritation. The spray felt great on my skin. I used after washing my face. It provided hydration with out feeling oily or sticky. It absorbs really quickly when you pat it into your skin as recommended. It was extremely lightweight and can be applied throughout the day over sunscreen and makeup and is cooling making it great in the warmer months but is appropriate for year round usage.

My favorite part of the D'Alba serum spray is the spray feature. So refreshing and immediately my skin felt cared for. Calmed any redness or irritation i might have had. Just tapped in targeted areas and let it do it's magic. Worked perfectly under makeup and with my skincare routine. Definitely recommend it for mature skin, great pick me up for use at any time.

This mist is a lifesaver for oily skin! It's way lighter than the original, giving a natural glow without the grease. The ultra-fine spray feels cooling and fixes cakey makeup instantly. On a side note, the fragrance is strong, but the dew is worth it.
This aqua cooling spray is a must have for everyone! The spray is a very fine mist and my skin loves it! It makes my skin very hydrated

I have been enjoying using the d'alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray. It seems lightly hydrating and it absorbs quickly. My skin feels invigorated with it. The scent is pleasant but I cannot quite place it. I like the blue oil that needs to be shaken in. I do not love that the instructions say to spray it but not to inhale it. To avoid doing that, I spray it into my hand and then dab it on my face and neck. I received this product free from BuzzAgent in exchange for this review.

avis.titre: Very hydrating and great under the makeup
avis.texte: I use it under the makeup and over the makeup. It holds the makeup pretty well and keeps my face moist.

avis.titre: A quick skincare pick me up
avis.texte: The mist is ultra fine and lightweight, so it layers beautifully without disturbing makeup or leaving a heavy film. What stands out is how instantly hydrating it feels. It gives that dewy, refreshed look within seconds, especially when skin is feeling dry or tired during the day. There's also a subtle, clean scent that adds to the overall experience without being overpowering. I like using it both as part of my skincare routine and as a mid day refresh because it brings back that healthy glow without looking greasy. Overall, it's a great option if you want something convenient, hydrating, and easy to use anytime your skin needs a boost.
This mist is fun to use because I get to shake it up to blend the product before I apply it. It is easy to apply and refreshes my skin. I love the ingredients too!

I have been using this spray every day- it has a cooling sensation, very mild, and leaves my skin feeling very refreshed. It's not sticky at all which can be an issue. It just leaves my skin looking a little glowy and hydrated.

avis.titre: Great misting serum that is also refreshing!
avis.texte: I have been using this serum spay for over a week, and I already consider this to be an essential part of my skincare routine. The standout on this serum is the misting spray—it delivers a very fine, even mist that feels incredibly refreshing. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin hydrated without any stickiness or heaviness. It's perfect for a quick boost of moisture during the day or post cleansing layer before lotion and night cream.

*I received this product in exchange for my honest review*. I actually loved this product. I usually use milky toner after I wash my face. After trying this product for a week, I found that it actually did an ever better job of providing that cooling feeling than my usual toner does. It definitely felt hydrating and refreshing which is something my skin desperately needs. After I run out of this, I would definitely consider purchasing it again.

It feels so hydrating without needing too much. I love that you can apply it throughout the day to keep your skin from drying out. I used it even on super dry days and love it. I keep it at my desk at work where it is so dry. I have sensitive skin and had zero problems with this and I love that the scent is neutral.

I love this spray! I use it after the last step of my skincare routine as well as to refresh my makeup through out the day. It truly locks in the hydration in my skin and brings my makeup back to life. I get glass glowy skin without looking oily. I highly recommend!

This is a unique spray that instantly cools and moisturizes skin upon application. I used it throughout the day for a moisture boost and a plumping effect. It leaves my facial skin with a nice glow and layers well throughout the day. It has improved the appearance of my skin. I highly recommend it. d'alba sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program
This spray was hydrating and had a nice glistening sheen. It kept my dry skin hydrated.

I really enjoy using the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum spray. The mist is super fine and feels light and refreshing on my skin. It instantly gives my face a boost of hydration and a healthy glow without feeling sticky or heavy. I love using it throughout the day, even over makeup, when my skin feels dry or dull. The formula contains white truffle extract and hydrating ingredients that help keep skin looking smooth and radiant. Overall, it's a refreshing serum spray that leaves my skin feeling soft, dewy, and revitalized.

avis.titre: d'alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray
avis.texte: As a disclosure, thanks d'alba for the free product to review! This spray was pleasant! I'm honestly not sure how large of a difference it made for me, but it was light and I never felt any residue after applying. It has ingredients I like such as niacinamide to help improve the skin barrier and even my skin. My skin did not break out or get irritated, but it also wasn't like a miracle, life changing product. Over all, I'm happy I got to try it.

avis.titre: Great for lightweight hydration throughout the day!
avis.texte: I've been using this serum spray for a couple of weeks now, and it has quickly become part of my routine! This isn't one of those heavy mists that feel sticky, this one is incredibly lightweight. The "Aqua" version feels especially great for a quick burst of hydration without ruining my makeup. I use it while hiking (soOo good) and random times throughout the day. I have combination skin and this works well for me!

avis.titre: A Lightweight Mist That Instantly Refreshes My Skin
avis.texte: I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray for about a week now, and I'm really impressed. The mist is very fine and refreshing, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky feeling. It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and a healthy glow. I also love that I can use it before or after makeup, and even throughout the day when my skin feels dry. The only small thing for me is that the scent feels a little bit masculine, but it fades quickly and doesn't bother me much.

**I was given this product in exchange for my honest review** Primarily, I use toner to remove any residual traces of makeup or dirt, after I cleanse. For that purpose, it worked quite well. I'm not a fan of spraying my face, so I just sprayed onto a cotton ball and applied. It left my skin soft and hydrated, rather that tight and stripped, as is the case with many toners. No irritation whatsoever. I would definitely consider purchasing this product.

This moisture boosting cooling spray feels so good after applying! The spray comes out evenly and it looks so cool in the bottle! When you shake it, there is blue that gets mixed into the clear! It's so nice to have a product that moisturizes and cool without leaving your skin feeling greasy. Highly recommend recommended!

It is super light you do not even feel it is there in your skin, omg what an amazing feeling, words donot have enough to express my feelings, this micro feather mist is perfect for make up face, all day keeps me feel so refreshed, giving so cooling feeling all day, perfect my aging dry skin, love this product so much
cute packaging, easy to use. interesting color, need to shake it to mix it up. sprays nicely and leaves skin feeling moisturized. no oily or sticky residue

Honestly, I didn't see much difference with this. Yes it's refreshing but the fragrance was too strong for me. For something that is spritzed on the face a subtler scent would have been nicer. If you don't mind a lot of fragrance then maybe you might like this. The bottle is beautiful though and the spray is actually quite nice. This just wasn't for me.

I love the aqua serum spray! It's not only hydrating, but also moisturizing beyond what a typical facial spray can do. I travel a lot and you get that dry crackly feeling when you're flying? Typical facial spray wets your skin for a second, but as soon as the liquid evaporates from your skin you're left with even more dryness. It's typically because the process of evaporation pulls water away from your skin. Most facial sprays do not have enough moisturizer keep your skin from drying eye. D'Alba serum spray contains multiple moisturizer and serum ingredients to keep your skin moisturized. My skin feels supple and nice after just one spray. It's a must have item for traveling!

Great product, keeps you refreshed and moisturized all days, great feeling, I love the ingredients, very healthy and skin friendly, I sprayed it couple of times a day, it has become my permanent routine since I have started using it.

The product's texture is excellent. The pump is gentle and makes it very easy to dispense the product. After using the serum, my skin looks instantly radiant, smooth, and plump, with a light, pleasant scent. Overall, I really like it. ✨

D'Alba kindly gave me the White Truffle Refresh Aqua Serum Spray for free so I could review it. I keep reaching for it all day. My skin gets pretty dry, so when my face starts feeling tight I just spray a little. The mist is super fine. It feels light and refreshing and there's no sticky feeling after. My skin just feels more comfortable right away. I've also sprayed it over makeup a couple times in the afternoon and everything still looked fine. Honestly, it's just a nice product to have around.

This Refresh Aqua serum spray is so refreshing and fun to use.
